prior_negative.no_reuse: Do not retune, replay as new evidence, or claim fresh science on consumed CAP03 seeds.

hypothesis: A bounded history-dependent predictive-state splitter can improve causal prediction by inducing a latent state from witnessed action/consequence history, without receiving private simulator state, and without losing the original trained Yggdrasil cumulative knowledge. It does not claim unrestricted unseen physics invention.

source.type: prospective synthetic DEV; no first-use yet
source.phase_labels: familiar A / unfamiliar history-dependent rule B / familiar A return
source.action_schedule: Precommitted deterministic uniform coverage of 4 public binary intervention pairs. One genuine sequential action/consequence observation per step; no invented counterfactual labels.
source.hidden: private source family, latent, phases and evaluator truth NEVER input to learners
source.first_use_fence: Source generator for registered DEV seeds and scored results must not run until independently qualified engineering fixtures and separately authorized source-first-use.

parent_custody.restore: Actual originally trained CAP03 native and six learned JEPA heads per original OS receipt, continued without restart
parent_custody.archive: Preserve original history, original native readout and CAP03 source/receipt bytes with their original hashes.

mechanism.input: public paired 3-bit views, current binary intervention pair, genuinely witnessed prior events only
mechanism.gate: Precommitted source-only prequential log-likelihood evidence for split vs pooled causal readout, with fixed complexity penalty and shrinkage
mechanism.forecasts: Stage-1 before current s2; stage-2 after current witnessed s2 but before current y
mechanism.scope: Finite bounded feature induction from history; no transformer/tokens, private phase, latent label or future outcome.

controls: fully trained full-history exact state/action Beta
fully fitted regularized linear history model
retained native/archive and CAP03 contrast descriptive only
matching: Fit every primary arm from exactly the same preexisting public native episodes, then from the same 96 genuinely witnessed actions/consequences, score before observe. Report independent compute and memory; no efficiency claim without compute matching.

scoring.metric: prequential mean Brier for genuine stage-1 transition and stage-2 terminal reward, equal weighting, pooled future steps 48..95, novel 48..71 and familiar-return 72..95, separate each DEV seed
scoring.go: Both DEV seeds: pooled >=0.005 better (lower Brier) than each fully fitted conventional/sham control, novel and cold-return each no worse than strongest control by 0.010, old archived readout byte and predictions unchanged, independent source/cold custody and dual-OS parity PASS
scoring.stop: Any failure => DEV_NO_GO or SOURCE_INVALID. Never adapt threshold or regenerate consumed DEV seeds. Passing development is DEV_FEASIBLE_NOT_SCIENTIFIC, not SCIENTIFIC_PASS.

budget.initial_step: Engineering fixture only, zero registered-seed scoring
budget.record: wall, CPU, RSS, checkpoint bytes, counters, entire source/version/provenance
